title: DeepSeek releases open V4 models adapted to Huawei Ascend chips
summary: DeepSeek previewed MIT-licensed V4-Pro (1.6T params) and V4-Flash with 1M-token context, near-frontier benchmarks and support for Huawei Ascend processors.
reason: Strong open-weights model near frontier, reducing dependence on Nvidia and on closed labs.

title: Maine governor vetoes first-in-nation data center moratorium
summary: Gov. Janet Mills vetoed the moratorium because it lacked an exemption for a project in Jay, promising an executive-order study council instead.
reason: Rollback of the backlash measure passed Apr 14.
